cards.say: A **context window** is how much text the model can consider at once: your prompt, the chat so far, and its reply so far. Text outside the window is invisible to it.

cards.q: A long chat goes on and the assistant forgets a detail from the start. What's the likely cause?
options: The early text no longer fits in the context window
The model chose to ignore you
cards.why: The model can only work with what fits in its window. Very long chats may push early messages out or get summarized, so details can be lost.

cards.q: Which of these usually counts toward the context window?
options: Your prompt and the reply so far
cards.why: The window holds both the input and the output, measured in tokens.

cards.q: One tip is bad advice. Tap it.
sentences: Put your key instruction clearly, and repeat it near the end.
Give only the sections of a document that matter.
Paste 500 pages and expect every detail to get equal attention.
cards.why: Models can miss details in very long inputs. Short, focused context usually gives better answers.

cards.q: Match each problem to a fix
pairs: The chat has grown very long
Start fresh with a short summary
You need answers from a huge report
The model keeps ignoring a rule
Restate the rule clearly near the end
cards.why: Every fix comes down to giving the model less, and more relevant, text.
